change_vs_ref: + --aug_apm_p 0.3 (WebRTC NS pass on 30% of clips; --aug_apm_ns_levels left at default 6 12 18 21)
rationale: This is the first iteration of a pre-registered screen. wave.json lever_notes say: "iterations a-c are the queued arms in this order, apm_ns -> opus_plc -> dtx_gate, each exactly its `set` on top of B2f's argv". plan_snapshot.md row a is `apm_ns` `--aug_apm_p 0.3`. The wave has no earlier iterations or reports, and user_notes.md has no steering notes, so the queue order applies. The evidence points the same way. On the largest remaining error in B2f's half_B readout (local_eval/{merge_top5,epoch_8}/metrics.json), sim_heldout_v1 is the weakest set. Its F1 is 0.8792 / 0.8827 (merge / final), with recall_bona 0.6931 / 0.6982 against recall_spoof 0.9900 / 0.9913. dev_online_clean F1 is 0.9760 / 0.9769. That noisy-bona deficit is the recurring B2/B3 error. rdloop/B4/FINAL_SUMMARY.md says heldout carries "4.23 / 4.11 of the missing WF1" and ranks apm_ns first as the best-powered contrast. Constraints: one factor (`--aug_apm_p`, part of the coupled group [--aug_apm_p, --aug_apm_ns_levels]; the levels stay at the trainer default [6, 12, 18, 21], as the plan specifies). The flag is in `allowed`, nothing forbidden is touched, the fixed flags are unchanged, and num_epochs stays 8 (max 10). batch_size stays 16 per the plan. No derived values are needed.
hypothesis: B2f reads suppressor artefacts on noisy speech as synthesis. Per the wave.json lever_queue, among offline sources NS-treated heldout bona trails untreated bona (69.2 vs 75.5, full set, final, logit gap 0.85, mostly afftdn). B2f never trained on audio that went through a noise suppressor. One pass of pywebrtc_audio's NoiseSuppressor on 30% of training clips, applied to both classes after the acoustic stage and before DTX/codec, should make suppressor artefacts class-neutral. The effect should transfer to the unseen afftdn/anlmdn suppressors in sim_heldout_v1 and raise heldout bona recall without costing spoof recall.
predicted_signature: Mechanism (scripts/b4_dsp_slices.py --lever apm_ns, --ref = B2f's same readout, offline-with-NS vs offline-without-NS bona, full set, final). 'Shown' requires all of: DiD <= -0.22, bootstrap CI upper < +0.32, clip DiD >= -1.3, half-B DiD < +0.57 (final) / < +0.23 (merge), and the placebo condition (NS DiD below the opus_plc and dtx_gate arms' NS DiD; this can only be read once those arms exist, so it is judged at the wave SUMMARY). Secondary: afftdn-vs-anlmdn DiD < -0.84. Outcome: sim_heldout_v1 F1 up >= 0.8 point from 87.92 / 88.27 (merge / final), driven by recall_bona rising from 69.31 / 69.82 with recall_spoof staying near 99.00 / 99.13. Expected half_B WF1 delta 0 to +0.6 vs 91.98 / 92.14. Must not move: dev_online_clean F1 within 0.5 of 97.60 / 97.69; sim_matched_v1 F1 down <= 0.5 from 91.22 / 91.24; R_spoof within 0.5 on every set; full-set offline-NS spoof misses <= 29; ep1 TrainAcc within 2 of 87.36 (B2f train.log l.1).
falsifier: (1) Mechanism refuted: NS DiD >= +0.32 (no better than an average null retrain) AND heldout F1 delta < +0.5 on both readouts -> drop the lever. (2) half_B WF1 delta < -0.5 (outside the ±0.5 band) with matched F1 down > 1.0 -> losing raw-noise exposure costs more than it buys; drop, with one lower-p retry only if the mechanism was 'shown' without the run-anomaly flag. (3) Full-set offline-NS spoof misses > 29 on either readout -> the model learned 'NS => bona'; drop. (4) Shared under-fit: ep1 TrainAcc < 85.36 or ep8 TrainLoss > 0.0752 (1.5 x 0.050114, B2f train.log l.15), together with heldout bona recall down -> confounded. Verdict on the wave rule: positive = merge half_B WF1 delta > +0.5 with CI low > 0 and clean drop <= 0.5. Inside ±0.5 = null on the outcome; the mechanism verdict still stands.

header_text: B4a = B2f + --aug_apm_p 0.3 (apm_ns arm, first of the B4 screen; rdloop B4 module b4wave sha d163f934). Each training clip has a 30% chance of one pass through the WebRTC standalone NoiseSuppressor (pywebrtc_audio, NS only, no HPF/AGC/AEC), level drawn from 6/12/18/21 dB. The pass runs after the acoustic noise/RIR stage and before the codec, on both classes. Target: B2f's weakest set, sim_heldout_v1: F1 0.8792 / 0.8827 (merge / final) with recall_bona 0.6931 / 0.6982 against recall_spoof 0.9900 / 0.9913 (B2f local_eval metrics.json, half_B). On that set, NS-treated offline bona trails untreated bona (wave.json lever_queue apm_ns). The aim is to make suppressor artefacts class-neutral so heldout bona false alarms drop. Everything else is B2f's argv, 8 epochs, seed 1234.
expect: ^B4 APM NS: on p=0\.3 levels_db=\[6, 12, 18, 21\] backend=pywebrtc_audio\.NoiseSuppressor
